summary.text: Sheryl Cole is a Democratic state representative from Texas House District 46 who took office on January 8, 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Sheryl Cole earned a Bachelor of Arts in accounting and a Juris Doctor from the University of Texas.
Her career experience includes working as an attorney at the law firm of Wright & Greenhill from 1991 to 1995 and as staff counsel at the Texas Municipal League from 1995 to 2001.
Cole's committee assignments in the 2023-2024 legislative session were House Administration (vice chair), Business & Industry and Higher Education.
